name: metronome-gemini
description: Use /metronome and /html_replicate to investigate reporting folders and work with existing Metronome flows.

settings.name: Metronome local URL
settings.description: Local Metronome origin, usually http://127.0.0.1:8000. Leave blank for that default.

settings.name: Read-only PostgreSQL connection
settings.description: Optional postgresql://reader:password@host/database DSN. Leave blank to disable SQL analysis. Never use an upload account.

settings.name: Readable SQL relations
settings.description: Optional comma-separated schema.table names. SQL analysis is disabled until this and the reader connection are configured.

settings.name: Flow scope
settings.description: Comma-separated existing Flow IDs, or * for all flows on your installation. Blank means *.

settings.name: Portal site scope
settings.description: Comma-separated site IDs, or * for all sites plus local-file and Outlook sources. Blank means *.
